summary.text: Paul Strommen is a member of the Nebraska Unicameral Legislature representing District 47, and was elected in 2024, according to the Legislature's biography.
The Legislature lists Paul Strommen's occupation as a small business owner.

paragraphs.text: Paul Strommen was born on December 26, 1969, in Sleepy Hollow, New York.
Paul Strommen graduated from North Shore High School in 1989 and earned a B.S. from the University of Colorado-Denver in 1998.
Paul Strommen served on the Sidney City Council, including as vice mayor.
Paul Strommen is married to Kendra.
